_meta.note: Anonymized community builder data (identical to the DATA embedded in index.html). Loadout files reference: race/sign by exact key, weapons by array index, items by name+'|'+owner (owner in A/B/SRV), masteries by exact name. Weapons carry wskill (weapon skill: Blunt Weapon/Axe/Long Blade/Short Blade/Spear/Marksman) with wskill_src 'vanilla-ref' (authoritative, wsub gives 1H/2H subtype) or 'name' (heuristic, provisional); wskill null = untyped.
_meta.rank_semantics: Multi-rank family ranks are INCREMENTS that stack: owning ranks 1..N means every rank's stated magnitudes apply together, so summing fx across owned ranks gives the correct total (each rank is also bought separately - costs always sum, and all spent points count toward '500 Points Spent' gates). ONE exception: Shadowstalker's critical-strike-damage % (raw text only, not in fx) is Mug-style replacement - the highest owned rank's % applies (rank 3 = 90%, rank 5 = 150%), never the sum. Granted ACTIVE abilities vary by family (some replace the previous tier like Mug, some coexist like Focused Strike) but never affect these stat sums.
